ic_name: ARM CoreSight On-Chip Debug and Trace Architecture
opcode_synthesis_skipped_reason: L2.protocol_overview.half_duplex is not True and no explicit opcode/command-table heading was found in input/docs/. Free-form hex bytes in prose, SVG labels, or PDF text do not constitute opcode evidence.
protocol_type: Memory-mapped debug-register access architecture plus a trace transport. The debugger reaches every CoreSight component through the DAP (Debug Port + Access Port) as memory-mapped register accesses over the Debug APB; trace flows the other way as ATB transactions from sources through funnels/replicators to sinks. CoreSight is layered over the JTAG/SWD wire transport but is itself a component/register/trace architecture, not a line protocol.

request_packet_format.transmit_order: LSB first on SWDIO synchronous to SWCLK rising edges

field_breakdown.name: Start
field_breakdown.description: Always 1 — marks the beginning of a request packet.

field_breakdown.name: APnDP
field_breakdown.description: Selects which register space: DP (debug port) or AP (access port).

field_breakdown.name: Parity
field_breakdown.description: Even parity over APnDP + RnW + A[2] + A[3].

field_breakdown.name: Park
field_breakdown.description: Always 1 — drives SWDIO HIGH before Turnaround.

ack_packet_format.transmit_order: LSB first on SWDIO synchronous to SWCLK rising edges (target-driven)

valid_codes.name: OK
valid_codes.meaning: Target accepted the request; data field is valid.

valid_codes.name: WAIT
valid_codes.meaning: Target busy. Host must retry. Data field is meaningless.

valid_codes.name: FAULT
valid_codes.meaning: Sticky error has occurred (read CTRL/STAT, write ABORT, retry). Data field is meaningless.

ack_packet_format.invalid_codes: Any 3-bit pattern other than 001/010/100 is a protocol error. Host should line-reset and re-IDCODE-read.

data_packet_format.transmit_order: LSB first on SWDIO synchronous to SWCLK rising edges
data_packet_format.parity_rule: Single-bit even parity over the 32 data bits. On writes, host generates; target checks. On reads, target generates; host checks.
data_packet_format.direction: Host-driven on writes, target-driven on reads.

phase_2_turnaround_a.description: 1-bit Turnaround period — SWDIO transitions from host-driven to target-driven.

phase_4_data.direction: write: host → target / read: target → host

phase_6_turnaround_b.description: 1-bit Turnaround period — SWDIO transitions back to host-driven.

dp_register_catalog.name: ABORT
dp_register_catalog.purpose: Write-1-to-clear sticky errors; DAPABORT to cancel in-flight AP transaction.

dp_register_catalog.name: IDCODE/DPIDR
dp_register_catalog.purpose: Identifies DP: DESIGNER + PARTNO + VERSION + REVISION + MIN.

dp_register_catalog.name: CTRL/STAT
dp_register_catalog.purpose: Control + sticky status bits + power-up handshake (CSYSPWRUPREQ/ACK, CDBGPWRUPREQ/ACK).

dp_register_catalog.name: RDBUFF
dp_register_catalog.purpose: Returns data of previous posted AP read.

memap_register_catalog.name: CSW
memap_register_catalog.purpose: Control & Status Word — AddrInc[5:4] (Off/Single/Packed), Size[2:0] (8/16/32/64-bit), DbgSwEnable, Prot[6:0], Mode[3:0], TrInProg, DeviceEn.

memap_register_catalog.name: TAR
memap_register_catalog.purpose: Transfer Address Register — 32-bit system-bus address used by the next DRW transfer; auto-incremented per CSW.AddrInc.

memap_register_catalog.name: DRW
memap_register_catalog.purpose: Data Read/Write — data conduit; read returns value at TAR (posted), write pushes value to TAR on the system bus.

memap_register_catalog.name: BD0
memap_register_catalog.purpose: Banked Data 0 — direct access at TAR[31:4]+0x00.

memap_register_catalog.name: CFG
memap_register_catalog.purpose: Configuration — Big-endian / Long-address / Large-data support indicators.

memap_register_catalog.name: BASE
memap_register_catalog.purpose: ROM Table base address — bits[31:12] point to the 4 KB CoreSight ROM Table.

memap_register_catalog.name: IDR
memap_register_catalog.purpose: Identification Register — Type (0=JTAG-AP, 1=AHB3-AP, 2=APB-AP, 4=AXI-AP), Variant, Class, JEP106 designer.

channels.name: Debug transport (JTAG TAP or Serial Wire)
channels.description: JTAG (TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO) into a JTAG-DP, or Serial Wire (SWDIO/SWCLK) into an SW-DP; an SWJ-DP switches between them.

channels.name: DAP internal bus (DP -> AP)
channels.description: DPACC/APACC accesses select an Access Port and a register bank; the AP masters the on-chip bus.

channels.name: Debug APB (memory-mapped debug registers)
channels.description: Each CoreSight component's 4 KB register block is memory-mapped here; reached via the MEM-AP TAR/DRW.

channels.name: AMBA Trace Bus (ATB)
channels.description: Carries trace (ATDATA/ATID/ATVALID/ATREADY, AFVALID/AFREADY flush) from sources to sinks.

channels.name: Trace Port / SWO (off-chip)
channels.description: Parallel TRACECLK + TRACEDATA[n], or single-pin SWO.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: Explicit Turnaround: a 1-bit Turnaround SWCLK cycle is mandatory between every host-driven phase and target-driven phase. CTRL/STAT.TRNCNT may extend up to 4 cycles.
Per-transaction ACK: target signals OK/WAIT/FAULT in every transaction.
Posted reads: data of read N is delivered with the ACK of transaction N+1, or via DP.RDBUFF.
No per-byte CRC — single-bit parity over Request fields and over the 32-bit Data field is the only protocol integrity check.
Line reset: 50 SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH unconditionally returns the SW-DP to a known state.

frame_format.register_access: Memory-mapped read/write of a component's 4 KB block via MEM-AP TAR (address) + DRW (data) over the Debug APB.
frame_format.trace_framing: Trace sources emit protocol-specific packets (ETM trace protocol, MIPI STP for STM, ITM stimulus packets) onto the ATB; the TPIU/formatter wraps the merged stream so it can be split by trace ID off-chip.
frame_format.note: There is no single wire 'frame'; CoreSight is a component-register + ATB-trace architecture over the JTAG/SWD transport.

access_model.register_access: Debugger -> DP -> AP (MEM-AP) -> TAR=component base, DRW=data -> component register over Debug APB.
access_model.discovery: MEM-AP BASE -> top ROM Table -> walk entries -> read CIDR/PIDR/DEVARCH/DEVTYPE at each component base.

addressing.note: Components are addressed by their base address in the debug register space (discovered from the ROM Table); trace streams are identified by ATB trace ID, not by address.
